purpose: Prepared normalized input for a future offline JEV comparison. This packet does not authorize or execute JEV.

shared_evidence.scope: 20 V4 evidence files; all manifest entries previously verified.
Previously captured local rendered flow, viewport measurements, browser console, and blocked-font observation.
Prior evidence-index and analyst packet; not an independent specialist opinion.

specialist_inputs.attribution: One host-native Cloak skill pass; not Orchestra MCP or a separate model process. Exact model slug was not exposed.
Separate Assessment A design review and Assessment B detector-only context. Agent model identities were not exposed.

normalized_findings.claim: V4 captures show Material Symbol names such as home, arrow_forward, monitoring, volume_up, flag, and help_outline rendered as words when the Google Fonts stylesheet is blocked.
normalized_findings.acceptance: With external Google Fonts blocked, no raw icon ligature is visible at 320px, 390px, or desktop; action labels remain readable.

normalized_findings.claim: Question badges show technical values such as prediction and event_sequence. These are plain labels, not icon ligatures.
normalized_findings.acceptance: Decide approved learner-facing labels separately; no enum or snake-case identifier should appear unless expressly approved.

normalized_findings.claim: Assessment A sees apparent right-edge clipping in the V4 390px home screenshot, while V4/Cloak report no horizontal document overflow at 390px. Do not treat as confirmed overflow.
normalized_findings.acceptance: On a future authorized render, inspect visible bounds and document scroll width at 320px and 390px.

normalized_findings.claim: Home journey and navigation labels differ from cited UI semantics and practice-track coverage.
normalized_findings.acceptance: Human/product owner clarifies whether the home label names the full journey or a selected language pair and confirms entry-point wording.

normalized_findings.claim: Impeccable detector emitted [] with exit status 0 for staged index.html; it did not evaluate rendered states or accessibility.
normalized_findings.acceptance: Retain as narrow static evidence; do not use as proof that the UI has no defects.
